profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Software Engineering Manager
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the tech industry where I've taken roles as senior software engineer and engineering manager. I've worked in agile teams and have also been the manager of an agile software team using the scrum framework throughout the software development cycles. I have 10 years of coding experience in Python, JavaScript, C++, and SQL. I have worked on backend microservices, APIs, relational and non-relational databases using SQL and NoSQL. I also have experience developing  front-end GUIs in JavaScript React and Python/C++ using the Qt framework.

company.name: Sigma Design, Product Design and Engineering

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Create flexible software interfaces to support and automate manufacturing processes in a fast-paced prototyping environment. Created RESTful APIs (serverside microservices) using Python framework Flask and developed data models and data pipelines to ingest manufacturing data to a NoSQL MongoDB as well as SQL database. Collaborate with a software team that has adopted the SCRUM process framework with biweekly sprints. Created docker containers to facilitate the development process as well as for testing. Developed User Interfaces using Javascript (React) & Python (PyQT5).

positions.title: Quality Assurance Manager/Engineer
positions.description: Responsible that the devices we make meet quality standards. Design tests/experiments in order to determine how the instruments perform and how to best improve them. Analyze all the data collected in the tests/experiments using Python, statistical software Minitab, and Excel. Provide leadership throughout the tests/experiments. Implement automation in testing and manufacturing using Python. Develop and maintain database for manufacturing using Python, VBA, and SQL

positions.title: Engineering Intern
positions.description: Design a working electrode for an electrochemical sensor using platinum black nanoparticles. Help design a model for a spectrometer to measure the total soluble solids of fruit using multivariate statistics.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Teaching Assistant for MECH 101(Intro to Mechanical Engineering - Fall 2012), MECH 404 (Heat Transfer - Spring 2013 & Spring 2014), MECH 303 (Fluid Mechanics - Fall 2013).Tasks include helping students with homework, grading exams and homework, and lecturing

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description: Researched and developed thermal systems. Designed system parts using 3D CAD software (SolidWorks) and 2D drawings for manufacturing. Worked with teams of engineers and other technicians within manufacturing. Lead a team of undergraduate students to build an apparatus to test performance of the system. Created and maintained detailed technical documents and notes of experiments and setup procedures.

positions.title: Math & Physics Tutor
positions.description:
I tutored students of all ages ranging from elementary to undergraduate students. Subjects ranged from arithmetic up to multivariable calculus.

Also tutored physics in the high school and undergraduate level.

projects.title: FEASIBILITY OF GALINSTAN-BASED MICROCHANNEL HEAT-SINK FOR HIGH HEAT-FLUX THERMAL MANAGEMENT
projects.description: Galinstan is a liquid metal which expected to be extremely helpful in increasing heat sinks (Microchips) heat transfer rate. The apparatus is designed and built with two other graduate students. Currently we are doing experiments on the effects of different percentages of water-galinstan mixture to enhance the heat transfer rate.

projects.title: Liquid Metal (Galinstan)
projects.description: Collaborated with another graduate student and two advisors (faculty members) on how to build the apparatus to test the performance of liquid metal galinstan through a microchannel. I built the apparatus with the other graduate student and installed all the sensors (pressure transducers and thermocouples) to gather data. Currently troubleshooting the testing apparatus to ensure it is working effectively.

publications.title: EXPERIMENTAL STUDY OF A PULSATING HEAT PIPE USING NANOFLUID AS A WORKING FLUID
